channels_thread_parent_check.name: channels_thread_parent_check
channels_thread_parent_check.value:
("channels"."type" = 'thread' and "channels"."parent_id" is not null and "channels"."parent_message_id" is not null)
    or ("channels"."type" <> 'thread' and "channels"."parent_id" is null and "channels"."parent_message_id" is null)

grants_member_identity.name: grants_member_identity
grants_member_identity.where: "grants"."member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grants"."policy_id" IS NOT NULL

grants_role_identity.name: grants_role_identity
grants_role_identity.where: "grants"."role_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grants"."policy_id" IS NOT NULL

grants_subject.name: grants_subject
grants_subject.value: ("grants"."member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grants"."role_id" IS NULL) OR ("grants"."role_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grants"."member_id" IS NULL)

grants_one_scope.name: grants_one_scope
grants_one_scope.value: ("grants"."project_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("grants"."channel_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("grants"."mailbox_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("grants"."gadget_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("grants"."gadget_version_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("grants"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL) <= 1

grants_scope.name: grants_scope
grants_scope.value: "grants"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL OR "grants"."project_id" IS NOT NULL OR "grants"."channel_id" IS NOT NULL OR "grants"."mailbox_id" IS NOT NULL OR "grants"."gadget_id" IS NOT NULL OR "grants"."gadget_version_id" IS NOT NULL OR "grants"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL

grants_agent_limits.name: grants_agent_limits
grants_agent_limits.value: "grants"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("grants"."daily_runs" IS NULL AND "grants"."expires_at" IS NULL)

grants_policy_scope.name: grants_policy_scope
grants_policy_scope.value: ("grants"."policy_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("grants"."channel_id" IS NULL AND "grants"."mailbox_id" IS NULL AND "grants"."gadget_id" IS NULL AND "grants"."gadget_version_id" IS NULL AND "grants"."connection_id" IS NULL)

grants_channel.name: grants_channel
grants_channel.value: "grants"."channel_id" IS NULL OR ("grants"."role_id" IS NOT NULL AND ("grants"."permissions" & ~112) = 0)

grants_mailbox.name: grants_mailbox
grants_mailbox.value: "grants"."mailbox_id" IS NULL OR ("grants"."member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grants"."permissions" IN (536870912, 1610612736, 1610612738))

grants_gadget.name: grants_gadget
grants_gadget.value: ("grants"."gadget_id" IS NULL AND "grants"."gadget_version_id" IS NULL) OR ("grants"."role_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grants"."permissions" = 1024)

server_identity_uuid_check.name: server_identity_uuid_check
server_identity_uuid_check.value: length("server_identity"."id") = 36 AND substr("server_identity"."id",15,1) = '4' AND substr("server_identity"."id",20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b')

users_active_role_check.name: users_active_role_check
users_active_role_check.value: "users"."status" <> 'active' or ("users"."role_id" is not null and "users"."joined_at" is not null)
